description: Recycling Victoria waste and resource recovery infrastructure is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Recycling Victoria waste and resource recovery infrastructure represents locations and operational details of recycling and resource recovery infrastructure in Victoria. The data is presented in webmap vic. gov. au/webmap/recyclingvictoriainfrastucturemap/. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Environment, Location. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
